# Vendored HDiffPatch source

This directory contains the `libdivsufsort` subset required by tinyuz. The
files are unmodified from
[`sisong/HDiffPatch`](https://github.com/sisong/HDiffPatch), verified against
commit `3b9dca715ca492873bf2c49e22e5d5b7d2a78620` (`v5.1.3`).

HDiffPatch and libdivsufsort are distributed under the licenses reproduced in
`LICENSE`.
